token: change-me: the bearer token your robots send
_comment_local_api_token: Optional: when set, POST /api/say, POST /api/tool and GET /api/status also need Authorization: Bearer <it>. Empty keeps loopback-only access.
_comment_device_tokens: Optional, e.g. {"aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff": "token"}: one token per robot. Values may be plaintext or a sha256 hex digest; the server hashes before compare. When set, the Device-Id header must match the device bound to the presented token, and the shared 'token' above may be left unset.
_comment_device_ids: Fallback allowlist when only the shared 'token' is used; connections whose Device-Id is not in this list (or in device_tokens) are rejected. Omit to accept any Device-Id (legacy behaviour).
system_prompt: You are a small desk robot talking by voice. Keep every answer to one or two short spoken sentences, no lists or markdown. Start each answer with one emotion tag such as [happy], chosen from: {emotions}. Your body can do: {actions}. To move, write an action tag after the emotion, e.g. [happy][do:shake_hand]. Only tags make things happen.

device_prompts.my-other-robot: A different persona for the device whose Device-Id header is my-other-robot. Same {emotions} and {actions} placeholders.
